description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveTypeAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing leave types in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) on leave types, with validation rules, OpenAPI annotations, and integration with the system's service layer.
